definition: This dimension controls the intricacy of crafting recipes, influencing how many ingredients are required, the variety of combinations possible, and whether recipes have prerequisites or dependencies. It varies from simple, straightforward recipes to complex systems requiring knowledge of multiple interactions and advanced planning.
exclusion_criteria: Recipes that consist of only a single ingredient.
Crafting systems with no dependencies or prerequisites.
inclusion_criteria: Recipes require varying numbers of ingredients from one to many.
Some recipes may depend on previously learned or discovered recipes.
title: Recipe Complexity
